props.name: name
props.description: Name of this panel. Used when referencing the panel in useDetailsPanel.

props.name: exclusive
props.description:
An optional identifier to prevent other panels with the same identifier
from being open at the same time.

bindings.name: item
bindings.description: Object the panel was opened with.

bindings.name: close
bindings.description: Callback to close the panel. The optional reason will be passed to the `onClose()` callback.

bindings.name: header
bindings.description: Native slot name for header content

bindings.name: footer
bindings.description: Native slot name for footer content

bindings.name: content
bindings.description: Native slot name for main content
